title: Wayline Work Spec v1
description: Canonical normalized specification of one unit of work. Attached to a work_item as an artifact and used to render prompts, dispatch agents, dedupe repeated signals, and validate outcomes. Synthesized from jay/issue_workflow/issue_spec_schema.json (AgentFixIssueSpecification), ns_obv/docs/issue-automation/issue-record.schema.json (Issue Record), and clinical-demo/src/clinical_demo/issues/workflow.py (IssueSpecification). v1 is additive; new optional fields may appear without bumping schema_version. Breaking changes ship as wayline.work_spec.v2.

kind.description: Coarse category. Reserved values in v1: 'repair', 'review_finding', 'repairable_failure', 'capture'. Callers may use other strings; reservation is non-exclusive in v1.

dedupe_key.description: Semantic identity. Two work_specs with the same dedupe_key collapse to the same work_item. Distinct from the HTTP Idempotency-Key header (transport retry identity), the work_spec fingerprint (content identity), and event_id (immutable fact identity). Stable across retries and across processes; choose values like 'repo:jay:repair:worker-retry-budget'.

title.description: Short human label used in lists, notifications, and the work_items.title column.

priority.description: P0 (highest) through P3 (lowest). Mirrors the priority field in all three source schemas (jay, ns_obv, clinical-demo).

objective.description: One-sentence statement of what done looks like.

details.description: Human-readable diagnosis or context. Maps to ns_obv.diagnosis, jay.details, clinical-demo.diagnosis.

source.description: Where the signal that produced this spec came from. Required when known; omit only for owner-originated work.

kind.description: Reserved values: 'review_finding' (clinical-demo, ns_obv), 'system_event' (jay UnifiedLogger.emit with repair=...), 'webhook', 'manual'. Callers may use other strings.

identifier.description: Stable identifier within the source kind. Example: '2026-04-22-codex-review:finding-001' for a review finding, or the upstream event id for a system event.

external_ref.description: Optional pointer to the originating artifact (file path, URL, opaque ref).

target.description: Where the work needs to land. Optional; not all work is repo-scoped. Generalizes ns_obv.location and clinical-demo.IssueLocation by adding 'repo'.

acceptance_criteria.description: Checkable conditions that must hold for the work to be considered done. Used by the eventual review endpoint. Required and non-empty per all three source schemas.

validation.description: How a reviewer or agent verifies the acceptance criteria. Unifies jay.validation_steps with ns_obv.verification {commands, notes}.

commands.description: Shell commands to run, in order.

notes.description: Human guidance for verification (for example, 'run targeted tests first if available').

constraints.description: Negative requirements (do-not-do statements). Used to keep an agent from drifting into adjacent fixes.

labels.description: Free-form tags. No canonical list in v1.

implementation_notes.description: Optional hints for the implementer. Preserved from jay's contract.
